clips.title: The story
paras: At Ironforge's Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge keeps weapons flowing to the Alliance. He coordinates iron deliveries and arms defenses across Khaz Modan and beyond.

Tormus Deepforge oversees the Bronzebeard clan's metalwork beside the Great Forge fires. He still hammers steel himself, but he also mourns Sturgy Ironband, his mentor. Dark Iron dwarves overran Sturgy's smithing compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh after a load of strange umbral ore arrived there.
